name: How long does a built-in shelving installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a built-in shelving installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most residential built-in shelving installations take between three to seven working days to complete. The timeline depends heavily on the project scope, such as whether your design includes integrated base cabinets, custom crown molding, or integrated electrical work like accent lighting. The initial phase involves precise on-site measuring, structural framing, and anchoring into wall studs. This is followed by finish carpentry, drywall patching if wall adjustments were required, sanding, and final interior painting or staining. Large basement entertainment centers or living room fireplace surrounds may take slightly longer, especially when coordinating trade work for hidden wiring or moving outlets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most built-in shelving projects take 3 to 7 days, depending on overall size, cabinetry integration, drywall adjustments, and custom paint or stain finishes.
